results.q: What must AI providers do for synthetic media under the EU AI Act?
results.answer: Under the EU AI Act, AI providers are required to mark their synthetic media outputs as artificially generated in a machine-readable way and must disclose when people interact with an AI system or see AI-generated content. This ensures transparency and helps users distinguish between real and synthetic media. [source: EU AI Act Art.50]

results.q: Under GDPR, is biometric identification data specially protected?
results.answer: Under GDPR, biometric identification data is specially protected as a unique category of personal data, as specified in Article 9 of the regulation. [source]
